title: Talon Nickel Award Obligation and Outlay Snapshot
publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, USAspending
summary: USAspending identifies award DEMS0000003 to Talon Nickel (USA) LLC and separates federal obligations, reported outlays, non-federal funding, and the current performance period for Project Double Play.
key_findings: The captured record reports $114,846,344 obligated and $954,321.45 outlayed.
The record reports $250,881,777 in non-federal funding.
The current end date is October 31, 2026, making later award transactions and facility records dated follow-up gates.
why_it_matters: The record is a clean administrative baseline for testing whether funded critical-minerals processing progresses into a permitted, built, commissioned, and operating facility.
ftfn_relevance: Separates award value, obligation, outlay, and non-federal contribution.
Anchors later facility and transaction checks to a named award identifier.
evidence_limits: Award administration does not prove permitting, construction, equipment installation, feedstock, qualification, offtake, or production.
USAspending values can change with later reporting and transactions.
